prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 1830px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表，用于按项目快速了解负责人、预算、进度与风险，支持管理审阅和横向比较。","reading":"以行为单位先定位项目，再扫读负责人、预算和进度；预算需要纵向比较，进度和风险用于发现异常，风险说明通常在最后细读。","groups":["项目+负责人：项目身份与责任归属，应相邻阅读","预算+进度：执行度量，适合并排比较","风险说明：独立的问题叙述列，承载长文本"],"keep_intact":["预算金额（含千分位与两位小数）","负责人姓名","短进度状态词（如“已完成”）","表头文字与“一网通办”等固定说法"],"may_wrap":["较长的项目名称（按中文词边界换行）","较长的进度描述","风险说明长文本"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [60, 70, 84, 61, 84] · table 360×3264px · row heights [60, 734, 548, 571, 594, 757] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 32 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r1B: widths [60, 70, 84, 55, 90] · table 360×3195px · row heights [60, 711, 548, 571, 571, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 31 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r1C: widths [58, 70, 84, 52, 95] · table 360×3171px · row heights [60, 711, 548, 571, 571, 711] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 30 lines · mid-word splits 3

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"负责人70px、预算84px都有余量，姓名和金额完整；风险表头单行；项目与负责人相邻，身份组清楚。","problems":"项目60px把项目名压成约2字/行；进度61px使“已完成”断成两行，长进度几乎逐字堆叠；风险84px只有约4字/行，表高3264px。","cause":"负责人和预算各多出约3px/2px余量未释放，项目/进度低于可读阈值；风险作为最长文本只拿到84px，行高被拉爆。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"三者中最佳：风险90px使表高降至3195px，风险表头单行；姓名/金额完整，仅1处词内断行。","problems":"进度55px过窄，“已完成”和进度描述被拆成约2字/行；项目60px仍偏窄；风险90px仍约4-5字/行。","cause":"为加宽风险从进度抽走6px，进度低于3字阈值；负责人70px、预算84px的5px余量没有用于进度。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"风险95px使表高最短3171px，风险叙述行宽最好；风险表头单行。","problems":"进度52px严重过窄，进度文本逐字堆叠，出现3处词内断行；项目58px也伤害项目名识别；仅比r1B短24px，代价过大。","cause":"过度偏重风险，把进度/项目压到可读阈值以下；负责人70px、预算84px的余量未释放，宽度分配失衡。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2-progress","widths":[60,67,82,60,90],"change":"以r1B为基础，只动有余量的负责人70→67、预算84→82，把5px给进度55→60；风险保持90。姓名/金额/风险表头仍完整，进度从约2字/行回到约2.6字/行，表高应略降。"},{"name":"r2-status","widths":[60,67,82,66,84],"change":"从r2-progress把风险90→84的6px转给进度60→66，让“已完成”等3字状态词完整成行；风险仍是最宽列且表头单行，但长风险叙述会更高。"},{"name":"r2-project","widths":[64,67,82,60,86],"change":"从r2-progress把风险90→86的4px转给项目60→64，进度保持60；项目名每行可多容纳约1字，行标签更易定位，风险仍接近90px。"}]}
